in_marathi.name: Kesava
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Stealer of Sins
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kesava हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Kesava is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Kesari', meaning 'having black hair'. This name is associated with Lord Vishnu and is often used to refer to him. The name Kesava signifies one who 'steals' sins from the hearts of devotees and frees them from the cycle of birth and death.

This name is associated with Lord Vishnu and is often used to refer to him. The name Kesava signifies one who 'steals' sins from the hearts of devotees and frees them from the cycle of birth and death.
